about_the_game:
"Kittenrock Cats - A Hidden Object Game" welcomes you to a richly interactive 2D world set in a picturesque mountain resort. The hand-drawn scene in Kittenrock is a labor of love, brimming with intricate details, natural beauty, and humorous Easter eggs, inviting thorough exploration and discovery.

The gameplay blends classic hidden object mechanics with a unique twist—interactive people and kitties around the map, enhancing the engagement and depth of the experience. Your primary goal is to spot the skillfully hidden kitties that merge seamlessly into the scenic resort surroundings, often revealed through playful interactions with the environment and its inhabitants.

Beyond the joy of discovering kitties, the game unfolds engaging mini-stories that add layers of depth and charm. These stories are woven into the fabric of Kittenrock, creating a narrative that celebrates exploration and curiosity.

In 'Kittenrock Cats - A Hidden Object Game' the game's zoom feature enhances your experience: zoom in to uncover intricate details and interact with characters, or zoom out to admire the whole scenic beauty of the resort. Whether you prefer a close-up exploration or a broader perspective, the game offers a uniquely engaging and visually stunning journey, encouraging you to discover hidden kitties and enjoy the diverse landscape of Kittenrock.

  • Engaging hidden object gameplay with an emphasis on observation and interaction.

  • Interactive characters that add dynamic layers to the gameplay.

  • Mini-stories linked to each discovered kitty, enriching the game's narrative.

  • A vast, interactive mountain resort environment filled with delightful Easter eggs.

  • Distinctive line-art graphic style enhances the game’s visual appeal.

  • Soothing and immersive background music, perfectly matching the game's rhythm.

  • A variety of achievements to encourage exploration and reward your discoveries.
